source.metadata_caveat: The BC Data Catalogue package wrapper records an Access Only licence because it fronts the ArcGIS portal application. The LidarBC portal, index item, and provincial open-data listing identify the data products as OGL-BC.
notes: CHM and canopy structure metrics are FEMIC-derived products, not separate LidarBC tile-index layers.
Individual-tree products are consumed from LidarBC where a suitable public product exists; FEMIC does not invent a new segmentation algorithm in P79.
Native CRS, vertical datum, spacing, point classes, and accuracy report links travel with each selected tile.
source.storage_boundary: P79.1 discovery is metadata-only. Tile bytes require an explicit instance or external-data root in P79.2; no provincial mirror is created.
source.title: LidarBC Open LiDAR Data Portal
